examples.text:

examples.text: […] the rain rashed down - the road was battered, As with the force of billows shattered; […]

glosses: An area of inflamed and irritated skin characterized by reddened spots that may be filled with fluid or pus. Also, preceded by a descriptive word (rare or obsolete), an illness characterized by a type of rash.

examples.text: He came out in a rash because of an allergy.
She applied rash cream on herself to reduce the irritation.

glosses: An irregular distribution or sprinkling of objects resembling a rash (sense 1).

examples.text: There has been a rash of vandalism lately.

examples.text: Ceux qu’on informait de la sorte ne devaient manquer de s’enquérir et l’irréfléchi devait forcément être démasqué, comme il advint.
